name: Saint John the Baptist
short_bio: Commemorates Saint John the Baptist, the forerunner of the Lord.
full_bio: Saint John the Baptist is remembered as the forerunner who prepared the way of the Lord.

name: Saint Georgios
short_bio: Commemorates Saint Georgios, the victorious martyr and beloved intercessor.
full_bio: Saint Georgios is remembered for his courage, faithfulness, and victory in martyrdom.

name: Abune Tekle Haymanot
short_bio: Commemorates Abune Tekle Haymanot, one of the greatest Ethiopian saints.
full_bio: Abune Tekle Haymanot is honored as a great Ethiopian monk, teacher, and holy intercessor.

name: Saint Yared
short_bio: Commemorates Saint Yared, master of sacred chant and Ethiopian hymnography.
full_bio: Saint Yared is honored for the gift of sacred chant and the shaping of Ethiopian liturgical music.

name: Kidus Estifanos
short_bio: Commemorates Kidus Estifanos, the first martyr of the Church.
full_bio: Kidus Estifanos is remembered as the protomartyr whose witness sealed the Gospel with blood.

name: Saints Peter and Paul
short_bio: Commemorates Saints Peter and Paul, pillars of apostolic witness.
full_bio: Saints Peter and Paul are honored as chief apostles and enduring witnesses of the Gospel.
